capabilities: Predict and complete the next word or phrase with Tab
Suggest wording alternatives from the right-click menu
Capitalise sentence starts, names, and abbreviations
Underline note-name matches for hover preview and linking
extras: Requires a one-time 86 MB language model download that can be declined; English only; the note-links feature is marked experimental; personalized learning is stored in personalization.json inside the plugin folder.
intentEvidence: Started as a fork of Various Complements by Tadashi Aikawa, since rewritten around a local neural language model.
problem: Obsidian's spellcheck only flags words; it does not correct typos automatically or predict the next word as you write.
